---
name: reaper
description: "."
applications:
  - id: reaper
    role: primary
---

Ask first, unless the request already answers it:

- Edit an existing `.rpp` (which file; is it open in REAPER now?) or start a new project?
- Deliver the edited project, a rendered mix, or stems? Which format and loudness target?
- Which plugins does the project need, and are they installed?

Know:

- REAPER runs a Lua ReaScript passed on its command line:
  `REAPER -newinst -cfgfile /absolute/project/.voyager/tmp/reaper.ini -nosplash /absolute/song.rpp /absolute/project/.voyager/edit.lua`
  (`-new` in place of the project starts a blank one). The binary is
  `/Applications/REAPER.app/Contents/MacOS/REAPER` on macOS and `reaper.exe` in the install
  folder on Windows.
- `-newinst` keeps the script off the user's running REAPER; a scratch `-cfgfile` keeps their
  preferences safe but has no licence or extensions, so an evaluation dialog can block startup.
- The instance stays open after the script: save in Lua (`reaper.Main_SaveProjectEx`), then
  close the process yourself. `defer` scripts and modal dialogs don't fit a one-shot run.
- A new instance cannot see unsaved edits in the user's window; don't overwrite an `.rpp`
  open there.
- Make music and sound effects with make-music and make-sound; transcribe dialogue locally
  with `voyager speech transcribe --local`; check renders with `voyager media review`.

To judge continuous motion, sync or how a clip sounds, use [hosted media understanding](../choose-media-model/references/understanding.md) (paid upload).
